class.name: HitscanSettings
class.brief_description: Editable hitscan range and linear damage falloff.
class.description: Used by [Hitscan3D]. Each query reads the current values. Invalid authored values are retained for inspection and reported by [method validation_errors]. Distances use world units; damage units belong to the project.

method.name: damage_at_distance
method.description: Returns full damage through [member falloff_start_distance], linearly decreases to [member damage] times [member falloff_min_multiplier] at [member falloff_end_distance], and retains that minimum through [member max_distance]. Beyond maximum range returns zero. Invalid settings or a negative or nonfinite distance return -1. Does not apply damage to an entity.

method.name: validation_errors
method.description: Returns authored configuration errors, or an empty array for valid settings.

members.member: Finite nonnegative start of linear falloff.
Finite end of falloff, strictly after its start and at most maximum range.
Finite damage multiplier between zero and one.
